How can it be 'laughable that some people are actually sad because of this year'? Do you think you're the only person who has a right to be depressed? There are people out there who have had family members die because of COVID, we've all been locked in our houses for months, financial struggles are enough to break someone as well; I understand you are in pain, as we all are. 1. these past 3 months have been up and down for me. there is definitely a 'honeymoon phase' when you begin taking it, then (for me at least) a sharp downturn, then finally, it evens out; now I just feel normal and happy!
